ACME TECHNOLOGIES — SYNTHETIC CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION MEMORANDUM

Acme sells an AI-assisted procurement platform to mid-market enterprises under annual subscriptions.
At 30 June 2026, management reported $12.0 million of annual recurring revenue across 48 customers.
Subscription revenue represents 90% of revenue; usage-based document processing represents 10%.
